property_summary: For any actor, settle() must revert when called before the target block has passed (block.number <= guesses[actor].block); the mutant removes this guard and lets settle succeed early (paying out when the blockhash is zero), breaking the rule.
change_summary: Delete the guard `require(block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block);` so settle() can be called before the target block, using blockhash(0) semantics.
